title: Thời trang / làm đẹp — thử đồ, phối đồ, lookbook, makeup, skincare
summary: Transformation on the beat: outfit changes and looks cut on the music with match cuts (same pose, same framing) and short speed ramps, each item labelled with its name and price, skin kept natural in the grade. Beauty claims are tightly regulated: show the routine, not promises.
signals: a person in full or half body, mirror shots
repeated framing with different outfits or looks
close-ups of face, skin, fabric, product textures

runtime.why: Outfit and look videos are rhythmic; length comes from the number of looks, not from holding them.

hook.purpose: the final look first, or the most striking change on a beat
hook.graphics: title (how many looks, the theme or the budget)

structure.purpose: one look or step per beat; match-cut the pose, whip between looks
the favourite look again and where to buy

music.mood: trend-friendly, clear downbeats for the outfit changes

compliance: Cosmetics: no treatment or medical claims (trị mụn, trị nám, trắng da cấp tốc, mọc tóc); TikTok bars before/after for acne, whitening and hair loss
No skin smoothing or reshaping filters on a product result; the grade is the same on every shot
Prices and sizes match the listing
Music licensed for commercial use (business account)
